one_line: Show the blank page and the product in the first second, then the finished result as the payoff.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down black-and-white giraffe colouring page, a hand lifting it. No speech. Pink text types in: "יום 2/10", "משחקי התפתחות בבית", "מאמא מרפאה בעיסוק | חלק 3". 0:01 a blow-pen box lies on the page.
q1_hook.why: A blank page and a box that says blow pen set up "what will this do?", and the series label and credential promise more ideas (H5, T3). The product is on screen at 1 s (S1). No face or voice opens it (against H4), and the text is only a label, not a benefit (H2).

beats.what: Blank giraffe page; the blow-pen box placed on it; title text
beats.why: Series label, credential and the product within a second

beats.what: A girl blows through a tube while an adult hand holds a marker over the page
beats.why: The odd action is the hook's answer

beats.what: Close-up of the tube and marker on the page, then a wider shot of the nearly coloured giraffe
beats.why: Colour spreads, so the page keeps changing

beats.what: Close-up of the paint spray and green leaves
beats.why: A texture shot that is nice to watch

beats.what: The finished coloured giraffe, then a close-up of its head

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. Caption, last paragraph: a comment word, "רוצים קישור לטושי נשיפה? כתבו לי “לינק״ בתגובות ואשלח לכם לפרטי!".
q2_flow.why: The blank page at 0:00 and the finished giraffe at 0:11 make a clean open loop and payoff (H5, R4). A new view about every second suits 12 s of content, with no dead air (R1, R2, E2). The comment word gives a real reason to respond (R6).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, last paragraph: "רוצים קישור לטושי נשיפה? כתבו לי “לינק״ בתגובות ואשלח לכם לפרטי!".
q3_cta.why: One ask with a concrete payoff, the product link by DM (C1, C2, C3). "לינק" is a generic word, easy to type. But the ask is only in the caption's last lines and never said or shown after the demo (against C6).

q4_shown.what: A blank giraffe page 0:00; the Maped Creativ blow-pen box 0:01; a girl about 3 to 5 blowing through a tube while an adult hand holds a marker 0:02-0:08; paint spray 0:09; the finished giraffe 0:10-0:11. No price; benefits only in the caption.
q4_shown.why: A blank-to-finished page is easy to read (R4, H5). The product shows at 1 s (S1) and a child does the activity (K8). The box is on screen about 1 s, so brand and where to buy stay vague (C7). The calming claim is only in the caption (K4).

q5_edit.what: At least 8 distinct shots in 12.5 s (the detector counted 14), about 1 s each, straight cuts, camera mostly static. Text typed in 0:00-0:02 only; no speech or subtitles. Ends on a close-up of the finished giraffe.
q5_edit.why: A new view about every second suits a 12 s demo (E1, E2, R2). The text is gone by 0:03 and nothing explains the action afterwards, so the message rests on the pictures and the caption (E4, T1). It stops on the result with no tail (E8, R4).

q6_topic.what: Day 2 of a 10-day series: colouring a giraffe page with blow markers, which an occupational therapist frames as mouth-muscle and calming play; it serves parents looking for home activities.
q6_topic.why: A doable activity from a professional answers a real parent need (K6, K4). The benefit bullets are specific, but "calms the nervous system" is a strong claim (K4). The series gives a reason to follow. The mood is calm, with only a mild peak at the finished picture (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Static top-down close-up of the page and box; a static side-on medium shot of a girl at a wooden table against a white wall in bright daylight, an adult hand entering from the right; close-ups of the spray and the finished page. Phone apparently propped.
q7_filmed.why: Bright even light and a steady propped phone give a clean, sharp home look (F7, H8). The child at table height puts the effort in view (K8). The finished page fills the frame (F4). The text overlaps the girl's hair and cheek at 0:02 (T4).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:02 pink text typed in, centred, about 18 to 31 percent down: "יום 2/10", "משחקי התפתחות בבית", "מאמא מרפאה בעיסוק | חלק 3"; it overlaps the girl at 0:02. No text after 0:03: no labels, subtitles or ask.
q8_text.caption: "יום 2/10: ציור בטושי נשיפה 🦒". About 117 words: series intro, what to do, four benefit bullets, a link ask with the comment word "לינק" in the last paragraph, 5 hashtags (#הורות #ריפויבעיסוק #kid #פעילותלילדים #ילדים). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: The first card sets series and credential (T3) but is gone by 0:03 and says nothing about blowing (T2), and "חלק 3" still contradicts "יום 2/10". The caption's first line names the activity in searchable words, with the ask at the end (T7, C6).

weak_points: Text gone by 0:03 and nothing explains the blowing; "חלק 3" against "יום 2/10"; the product box on screen for 1 s; the calming claim only in the caption; a child's face on screen.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a blank page, then the finished one, from above on a steady phone with the book in the first second. Put one comment-word ask in the caption.
not_verified: Speech or music: the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech; music cannot be told. Whether Maped supplied or paid (no label); box text read from the frame: "Blow pen", "5+". The girl's exact age. Correction: the box is on screen from 0:01; the title card says "חלק 3" next to "יום 2/10", as on her other Reel.
